name: Wooden Hands
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 1, druid 1, ranger 1, shaman 1, witch 1

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a chunk of wood)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You transform the target’s hands into wooden carvings.

While this spell is in effect the target is unable to manipulate, grasp, or release items. If they have no weapon equipped they can use, they gain a 1d6 slam attack. The target’s Cmd against disarm increases by 5. However, their hands are susceptible to spells that affect wood, like warp wood. At the end of the spell, the target’s hands return to normal, including any changes to the wood caused by other effects.
